conditions.name: Specific Phobia

ratingSchedule.note: DC 9403, specific phobia; the same diagnostic code also names social anxiety disorder.

reviewNotes: Keep this identity distinct from the existing social-anxiety-disorder catalog entry even though both are named under DC 9403.

conditions.name: Dissociative Amnesia / Dissociative Identity Disorder

ratingSchedule.note: DC 9416, dissociative amnesia and dissociative identity disorder.

reviewNotes: The stable roadmap id is broader than the current VA diagnostic-code label. This catalog identity is intentionally scoped to the diagnoses expressly named under DC 9416 rather than every possible dissociative presentation.

conditions.name: Functional Neurological Symptom Disorder (Conversion Disorder)

ratingSchedule.note: DC 9424, conversion disorder (functional neurological symptom disorder).

reviewNotes: Catalog placement follows the mental-disorders rating schedule; this does not imply that neurological symptoms should be diagnosed or medically attributed without qualified evaluation.

conditions.name: Body Dysmorphic Disorder

ratingSchedule.note: General Rating Formula for Mental Disorders; no single diagnosis-specific diagnostic code is assigned by this automated expansion.

reviewNotes: The current § 4.130 diagnostic-code table does not separately name body dysmorphic disorder. Do not borrow DC 9404 solely because DSM-5 groups the diagnosis with obsessive-compulsive and related disorders; qualified review must determine the proper rating treatment for an individual case.
